ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this“Agreement"), made as of the 6 day of xxxk&June_, 2019 (the “Effective Date"), by and between 590 6th Broadway, Suite 206, Brooklyn, New York 11249 (Developer"), and ST. SAVIOUR'S OF NEW YORK, a religious corporation formed under the Religious Corporation Law of the State of New York, having an address at 611 Eighth Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11215 (St. Saviour"). RECITALS: WHEREAS,St.Saviour is the fee owner of certain land located at 590 Sixth Street, Brooklyn, New York, previously known in its entirety as Tax Lot 7 in Block 1087 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings, as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexedheretoandmadeaparthereof,togetherwiththebuildingsandimprovementsthereon existing as of the date hereof(said land being herein referred to as the“Combined Land”and together with said buildings and improvements being herein referred to “collectively as the "Combined Property"): WHEREAS, pursuant to a certain Lease Agreement (the “Lease"), dated as of June 14, 2016, St. Saviour, as Landlord, leased to Developer, as ground lessee, the portion of the Combined Property consisting of the land described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a 590 Sixth Street, Brooklyn,NewYork),together with the 4-story existing building being herein referred to as the“DeveloperBuilding”and improvements existing on the Developer Land as of the date hereof (the Developer Land, the Developer Building and such other improvements are herein collectively referred to as the“Developer Property"); WHEREAS, pursuant to the Lease, St. Saviour has subdivided the tax lot comprising the Combined Land to create two (2) tax lot designations such that the St.Saviour Land is comprised of: (i) the portion of the Combined Land that is today generally improved with the St. Saviour Church and the Saint Savior School as depicted onExhibit C hereto(said land being herein referred to as the “"St. Saviour Land" said buildings and improvements being herein referred to as the “St. Saviour Buildings" and the St. Saviour Land and the St. Saviour Buildings being herein referred to collectively as the “St. Saviour Property" such land has been or will to be designated as the reconfigured Tax Lot 7 in Block 1087 on the Tax Map (as revised pursuant to such subdivision) and (i) the remaining portion of the Combined Land, the boundaries of which coincidewith the boundaries of theDeveloper Land,hasbeen orwill be designated asTaxLot 10 in Block 1087 on the Tax Map (as more particularly described on Exhibit D annexed hereto and made a part hereof); WHEREAS, pursuant to the Lease, Developer may construct certain improvements on Developer Property, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement or theLease. 23350045v12

WHEREAS, the parties shall utilize the procedures available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution to create a Merged Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) and make available to the Developer the Developer's Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the Developer Property; WHEREAS, in furtherance of the foregoing recital, the parties hereto are simultaneously  herewith  executing  and  delivering a  Declaration  of  Restrictions  (the "Declaration") as defined in subparagraph (d) of the definition of “zoning lot" in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, to create the Merged Zoning Lot; WHEREAS, all parties in interest (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the Merged Zoning Lot have joined in the Declaration or have waived or have previously waived their right to do so and have either executed this Agreement, or subordinated thereto; WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters; and NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of themutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1. Definitions. As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings assigned to such term in this Section 1, unless the context indicates otherwise. (a)“Agency(ies)" shall mean the New York City Planning Cominission, the Departinent of City Planning of the City of New York, the City Council of the City of New York, the New York City Department of Buildings, the Board of Standards and Appeals of the City of New York, the Landmarks Preservation Commission, the Brooklyn Borough President, any community board, any other municipal agencies, court or department, or any department, court or agency of the State of New York or the United States of America or any successor entity to any of the foregoing. (b) “Applicable Laws” shall mean any applicable codes, laws, permits, orders, rules regulations and directives of all governmental authorities, including,without limitation,requirements of the New York City Department of Buildings and state, federal, and municipal governmental authorities (d)“Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with (i) a total floor area determined by multiplying the area of the zoninglot by the maximum allowablefloor area ratiofor structures in the zoning district or districts in which such zoning lot is located, and (ii) by the inclusion therein of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by any City Agencies. 2 23350045v12
